# `company.pick_list_lines`

Immutable lines of a pick list: one order line's units from one bin, in pick order.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | — | Stable ULID of this line. |
| `pick_list_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + position | — | pick_lists.id | Pick list this line belongs to. |
| `position` | INTEGER | no | — | unique with pick_list_id + position | — | — | One-based position in pick order. |
| `sales_order_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | work_documents.id | Sales order the units are for. |
| `order_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | The order line's line_id, as `sales-order show` lists it. |
| `root_document_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_pick_list_lines_root | — | Billing root document of the order line (the order, or the estimate it came from). |
| `root_line_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_pick_list_lines_root | — | Billing root line identity of the order line. |
| `item_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | items.id | Item to pick. |
| `quantity_microunits` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Quantity to pick in the item's base unit, microunits. |
| `bin_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | inventory_bins.id | Bin to take them from; null for no bin. |
| `lot_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | lots.id | Lot suggested (earliest-expiring unexpired first); null when none. |
| `short` | BOOLEAN | no | — | — | — | — | True for the part of the order line nothing at the site holds. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this pick list line was recorded. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that recorded this pick list line. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that recorded this pick list line. |
| `audit_event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event that committed this pick list line. |
